parameters.name: AssetsType
parameters.description: The asset type of the instance.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the public IP address exposure. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query.

parameters.name: PublicIp
parameters.description: The public IP address of the instance.

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level. If this parameter is not specified, all risk levels are returned. Valid values:
- **3**: high risk
- **2**: medium risk
- **1**: low risk
- **0**: no risk.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the public IP address exposure. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
